text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: runtime-frontend.canary p95 latency spike (avg 780ms) and kernel_fallback_rate up 8x over last 3m for tag=hotwave-rollout-17. Rolling alert group: latency,paging,kernel-fallback. Auto-created incident #INC-2026-118.
marco (oncall): ack — I'm on it. paging eng-runtime and eng-sre.
marco (oncall): @sophie @jordan can you triage canary? I see increased tail latency and a bunch of kernel fallback logs.
sophie (eng-runtime): looking at canary logs now. hotwave-rollout-17 was deployed ~5m ago. initial canary traffic = 5%.
sophie (eng-runtime): fyi dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/runtime?p=hotwave-rollout-17 — p50 ok, p95 and p99 blown out. KV cache hit rate dropped 30%.
jordan (eng-sre): I'm seeing connection churn + micro-batching queues growing on nodes with kernel variant v2. Try switching canary to kernel=v1 fallback path?
marco (oncall): decision: pause routing to canary, enable ff kill-switch to stop rollout, then evaluate rollback. @ops-notify-bot please start customer impact checklist.
ops-notify-bot: Notifying: #cs-alerts, #sales-escalations, and customers with dedicated capacity. Template: "We detected elevated latency for LLM inference for a subset of requests; engineering is mitigating."
maya (product-ops): please include customer list for canary cohort A (wave id 42). I can prepare targeted emails if needed.
sophie (eng-runtime): pausing canary routing now: executed routing cutover -> set traffic to 0% for hotwave-rollout-17.
sophie (eng-runtime): command used: ```/bin/sh
# set canary weight to 0
redwoodctl rollout set-weight --release hotwave-rollout-17 --weight 0 --env prod
```
marco (oncall): got it. monitoring for p95 to drop back to baseline. also check kernel fallback metric after pause.
jordan (eng-sre): kernel_fallback rate dropped ~60% within 90s of pausing. but batch stall metric still elevated on two nodes in us-west-2.
sophie (eng-runtime): investigating node-level logs. suspect a microbatch config change that went out in hotwave rollout: batch_window_ms reduced to 8 from 12 which may increase churn at small seq lengths.
jordan (eng-sre): can we hotfix config via a config override instead of full rollback? If we revert batch_window back to 12 for canary nodes, maybe stabilize without impacting model binaries.
marco (oncall): quick tradeoff: rollback entire rollout vs targeted config override. If targeted override is low-risk and quick, do that first. Sophie, can you push override to canary nodes?
sophie (eng-runtime): pushing config override to affected canary pool now. ```kubectl -n runtime rollout restart ds/runtime-canary --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"batch_window_ms":"12"}}}}}'```
sophie (eng-runtime): override applied. Observability: prefetch queue depth started to fall. p95 down to ~420ms (from 780). kernel_fallback down further.
maya (product-ops): good progress. CS notified customers in cohort A with a brief update. No confirmed errors from customers yet, but they reported slower responses.
jordan (eng-sre): suggest we keep kill-switch paused for the rest of the wave until we validate metrics at 10m post-fix. Also start runbook checks: memory, threadpool, KV-cache warmup.
marco (oncall): agreed. keep traffic at 0% for hotwave until we have 15m of stable metrics. Escalate to eng-runtime lead if things reoccur.
ops-notify-bot: Update posted to #incident-status: "Canary paused, config override applied, p95 improving. Investigating root cause (batch_window change)."
sophie (eng-runtime): logging notes for postmortem: root cause likely uncoordinated change in microbatch tuning introduced in canary variant; caused increased kernel fallbacks and batch thrash at low traffic. Will collect flamegraphs and kv cache traces.
maya (product-ops): preparing a short customer-facing summary and an internal timeline for postmortem. I'll schedule the incident review at 16:30.
marco (oncall): handoff: I'm wrapping initial mitigation. @sophie you'll own root-cause analysis. @jordan please run node-level forensic for the two us-west-2 instances. I'll remain available for escalation.
incidents-bot: Incident #INC-2026-118 updated: status=mitigated (canary paused + config override), severity lowered to SEV-3. Next update in 10m or on escalation.
marco (oncall): thanks team. leaving this thread open for final confirmation. :thumbsup:
